text: ІННОВАЦІЙНІ МЕТОДИ ПРИЙНЯТТЯ УПРАВЛІНСЬКИХ РІШЕНЬ В БІЗНЕС-ОРГАНІЗАЦІЯХ В УМОВАХ ДІДЖИТАЛІЗАЦІЇ presents the following source proposition: The purpose of this article is to analyze Web3 tools, in particular blockchain, asset tokenization, decentralized finance (DeFi), and decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs), as a basis for forming new, more transparent, secure, and effective methods and models for management decision-making. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that A decentralized autonomous organization is merely computer code with no directors, managers or employees, its governance structure built with software, code and smart contracts running on a public decentralized blockchain platform.
